'''Pharen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Medic/Legends|medic]] who served as an assistant to [[Attros Finn]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Pharen worked as a consultant at the Jedi Embassy within the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on Coruscant. In [[3643 BBY]], Pharen assisted [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Attros Finn]] in briefing a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Knight]] for an assignment to track down the [[Noetikon of Light]]. Believed to be held by agents of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] gang on Coruscant within their own [[Black Sun territory|territory]] in the underworld, [[Pharen's sister]] had informed her that members of the gang were stockpiling weapons in the backroom of the [[Silent Sun cantina]] where she worked. While the Knight was searching for the Noetikon one of Pharen's patients, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yuon Par]], attacked her and had to be restrained.
